name: domainkit-workspace
description: DomainKit workspace for adding custom domains to apps with reviewable DNS plans.
author: Arya Labs

scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run lint:rules && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.docs:check: bun run typecheck:examples && bun run --filter @domainkit/docs docs:check
scripts.release:check: bun run check && bun run test:artifact && bun run docs:check
scripts.test: bun test scripts && bun run --filter ./packages/domainkit test && bun run --filter ./packages/capsuledb test && bun run --filter ./packages/react test && bun run --filter @domainkit/video test
scripts.test:artifact: bun run build && bun run --filter ./packages/domainkit test:artifact && bun run --filter ./packages/capsuledb test:artifact && bun run --filter ./packages/react test:artifact
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun run --filter domainkit build && bun run --filter './packages/*' typecheck && bun run --filter domainkit typecheck:examples && bun run --filter @domainkit/video typecheck
scripts.typecheck:examples: bun run build && bun run --filter @domainkit/examples typecheck
